info.title: Sun Tech WCS host API
info.description: The HTTP API of the WCS host under `/api/v1`, generated from the running host by tools/Wcs.ContractCheck (do not edit by hand). `info.version` is `HostApiContract.Version` (WCS/Wcs.Api.Contracts): its major part changes on a change an existing client would not survive. Every refusal is `application/problem+json`; the titles are the host's own words, in Italian (`x-wcs-problem-titles` lists them per answer): program against the status code and, for 503, the `unavailable` field. The SignalR hub `/hub/plant` is not described here (see guide/integration/host-api.md).

401.description: No key, a wrong key, or the key in the `access_token` query parameter.

200.description: The lease is granted or renewed to the caller (`isMine: true`). It lasts 60 seconds.

400.description: `holder` is empty. The body or a parameter cannot be read (not JSON, a wrong type, a required one missing): in the Development environment the title is `Richiesta non leggibile` with the parser's reason in `detail`, elsewhere the framework's `Bad Request`.

401.description: No key, a wrong key, or the key in the `access_token` query parameter.

403.description: The read-only key on a write.
x-wcs-problem-titles: Chiave priva del permesso di scrittura

409.description: Someone else holds the lease: the body names them (`isMine: false`).

204.description: Released; releasing a lease the caller does not hold does nothing.

400.description: The body or a parameter cannot be read (not JSON, a wrong type, a required one missing): in the Development environment the title is `Richiesta non leggibile` with the parser's reason in `detail`, elsewhere the framework's `Bad Request`.

itemId.description: Returns or Sets the unique identifier of the item

name.description: Returns or Sets the name of the AutomationDevice

asi.description: Returns or Sets the ASI of the element

partition.description: Returns or Sets the PARTITION of the element

subitem.description: Returns or Sets the SUBITEM of the element

delayBlind.description: Returns or Sets the waiting time in milliseconds for the move-completed report that follows a move command, this function is valid only for ConnectionType=Test

timeOutPlcMoving.description: Returns or Sets the waiting time for the move-completed report in milliseconds before reporting the move TimeOut

loadUnitImageHeight.description: Returns or Sets the graphic height of the load unit image (0 = default)

loadUnitImageWidth.description: Returns or Sets the graphic width of the load unit image (0 = default)

autoExecuteStep.description: Returns or Sets whether to automatically execute the movement micromission relating to the loaded PathMission

autoUnloadLoadUnit.description: Returns or Sets whether the loaded PathMission will be immediately logically downloaded

buildDestinationItemId.description: Returns or Sets on which element to move the loaded PathMission (This function is valid only if there are no destinations previously assigned to the PathMission)

buildDestinationItemId2.description: Returns or Sets on which element to move the loaded PathMission (This function is valid only if there are no destinations previously assigned to the PathMission)

connectionType.description: Returns or Sets the connection type to use

motionType.description: Returns or sets the Motion Type

getLoadUnitInfo.description: Returns or sets whether to request dimensional data and identification codes from the PLC when a PathMission is located on the AutomationDevice

lookWhereAllocateLoadUnit.description: Returns or Sets where to store the PathMission and if so, builds the movement mission

rejectItemWhenNoAllocation.description: Returns or Sets where the PathMission will be rejected if there are no cells available for storage

relocateItemId.description: It is the connected AutomationDevice responsible for storage (The property is valid only for Storage type items)

recordLoadUnitInfo.description: Returns or sets whether to register a new LU when receiving identification and dimensional data from the PLC

rejectItemWhenInfoError.description: Returns or sets where the PathMission will be rejected in case of error in reading the dimensional and identification information from the PLC

linkedCellId.description: Returns or sets the warehouse cell connected to the element, by valuing this property the system will track the PathMission that passes over it

storageOffset.description: Returns or Sets the storage quota offset

recordStorageLength.description: Returns or sets the Storage Quota Posting Type

deviceConnectionId.description: Returns or Sets the PCL device identifier

showInfoMessageAssignedLoadUnit.description: Returns or Sets if the PathMission is assigned to a note, shows an information message of the connected Note (This function is active only for Buffer type Items)

storeUnitStep.description: Returns or sets the value of the deposit for the balancing ratio between deposit and withdrawal

pickUpUnitStep.description: Returns or sets the value of the withdrawal for the balancing ratio between deposit and withdrawal

orderNumberInGroup.description: Returns or Sets the Cartesian position number starting from top to bottom or right to left plus (top = 0, right = 0)

groupItemId.description: Returns or sets the grouping number that allows the movement of multiple load units at the same time

groupRoutePathId.description: Returns or sets the level identifier of a group of AutomationDevices, this property is used during path processing to avoid returning to the same level of origin

priorityInRoutePath.description: Returns or sets the number of movement priorities in picking and depositing when multiple elements are connected to the same element, for example the CircularDistributor or the shuttle with multiple load units, in this way a picking or depositing priority can be set

timeLapseToExecuteStep.description: Returns or Sets the test execution time interval of the ExecuteStep command of a GroupItem

belongingGroupId.description: Returns or Sets the belonging AutomationDevice

groupLevelId.description: Returns or Sets the source level from which the item group will be accessed

waitingTimeForcedLoading.description: Returns or Sets the maximum waiting time for a GroupItem to load all the elements belonging to it

groupLoadingActive.description: Returns or Sets whether the group can pick up PathMission from the connected AutomationDevices Note: The option is active only for ItemType GroupOfAutomationDevices

groupTransferringActive.description: Returns or Sets whether the group can pick up PathMission in the connected AutomationDevices Note: The Option is active only for ItemType GroupOfAutomationDevices and only for those with Items not connected to Storage

groupedMoveLoadUnitTo.description: Returns or Sets whether the MOVE_LU_TO command is grouped for all the PathMissions contained in the AutomationDevices of the GroupItem

respectQueue.description: Returns or sets whether the AutomationDevice must respect the MissionStep queue

waitBelongedItemsEmptyBeforeLoading.description: Returns or Sets whether to wait until all elements of the group are empty before loading the PathMissions

storageOffsetReversed.description: Returns or Sets the Offset of the inverted storage quota

storagePartition.description: Returns or Sets the storage partition in case of fixed storage

storagePartitionReversed.description: Returns or Sets the storage partition in case of inverted fixed storage

triggerItemGetLoadUnitInfo.description: Returns or sets the source item for which to request the dimensional data and the identification codes from the PLC (The source item can be that of the previous step or the mission source)

triggerItemToExtractPoint1.description: Returns or Sets the item to check before performing an LU extraction

triggerItemToExtractPoint2.description: Returns or Sets the item to check before performing an LU extraction

distributeOnBuffers.description: Returns or Sets if when an extraction PathMission passes on this Item the system will balance the output on the buffers reachable from it using ReachableBuffers property

addStorageLengthLoadUnitDepth.description: Returns or Sets whether to add the UDC depth to the storage quota

enableDefragmentation.description: Returns or Sets whether compaction is enabled during loading of elements that are GroupItems

cellToDefragmentId.description: Returns or Sets the id of the cell to compact

acceptLoadUnitIfDestinationIsAvailable.description: Returns or Sets whether to accept a LU if the target is available

maxUnloadWeight.description: Returns or Sets the maximum weight that can be loaded on the AutomationDevice

extractionCheckPoint.description: Returns or Sets the point at which to consider the extracted UDCs for inventory notes

rejectDestinationUserRequest.description: Returns or Sets the rejection point on user request

timeOutGetLoadUnitInfo.description: Returns or Sets the waiting time for the response from the PLC for GetInfo

toBeFiltered.description: Returns or Sets whether the element should be considered filterable by PathMission with ActiveFilter set to true

onLoadLoadUnitActiveFilter.description: Returns or Sets whether when a PathMission is loaded it sets its ActiveFilter property to true

waitLookingLevels.description: Returns or Sets the number of items to check to see if PathMission is arriving for loading

fullKey.name: X-Api-Key
fullKey.description: The full key, host setting `Wcs:ApiKey` (required): every operation.

readOnlyKey.name: X-Api-Key
readOnlyKey.description: The read-only key, host setting `Wcs:ReadOnlyApiKey` (optional): GET operations and the hub; anything else is 403. The key is read from the header only: `access_token` in the query is refused with 401.
